messages:
maya: heads up — i'm sketching the tenant-sandbox permission surface. goal: let demo/preview tenants exercise most routes without granting prod entitlements. main concerns: ephemeral roles, quota overrides, and clear telemetry/audit. any quick takes?
jason: do you mean creating demo accounts that get implied elevated scopes at routing time (not stored as real role bindings)?
maya: exactly. two approaches: 1) preview roles that mirror real roles but are flagged ephemeral in the auth DB, or 2) a mapping/rewrite layer at request time that swaps scopes for requests from namespace=preview. both have tradeoffs around audit and quota.
priya: product note — must be fully auditable. if a demo request hits an admin-only route, audit logs need to show the org/tenant and that it was a preview mapping, otherwise compliance will freak.
dan: engineering note — mapping layer is easier for rollback and doesn't require migration of role data. downside: console/telemetry needs to know "preview vs prod" so dashboards and SLOs don't get skewed. we should tag requests.
kelsey: UX: show a prominent banner in the console "Preview tenant — permissions are simulated" + an "Effective permissions" preview panel that lists which prod routes are available. also prevent changing real role bindings from preview.
maya: rollout concerns: if we flip on preview_roles by default for new tenants, will we accidentally enable anywhere else (dedicated, private)? need a hard guard.
jason: simple guard idea: only allow preview flows in tenants with namespace: preview. policy service enforces. config example: allow_preview: true in tenant metadata.
maya: snippet for discussion:
```
tenant:
  id: tenant-1234
  namespace: preview
  preview_roles: [demo-admin]
  quota_override:
    token_rate: 200
    burst: 1000
```
dan: telemetry action: tag all requests from namespace=preview with preview=true and effective_role=demo-admin. update cost dashboards to filter by preview flag. also add a separate quota meter so demo usage doesn't count toward prod usage math.
priya: audit/events: record mapping events like:
- preview-mapping: tenant-1234 demo-admin -> limited-admin (timestamp, initiator=system, correlation_id)
we need schema for that.
permissions-bot: policy-check: preview roles are blocked for tenants with license: enterprise-prod.
maya: ok action items: dan -> implement request tagging + telemetry docs; kelsey -> banner + effective-perms panel copy and mockup; priya -> draft audit event schema; jason -> policy guard PR; i'll draft a canary rollout plan (10% sandbox tenants). sound good?
jason: :thumbsup:
dan: on it
kelsey: will mockup by EOD
priya: will open schema PR tomorrow
maya: thanks all — i'll post the rollout draft in #eng-releases later today.
